note: Run R1 (isolated database flight_delay_reliability_test, group reliability-test, topics reliability.*; 60,000 events at 1,000/s; broker stopped 18:29:13 and started 18:29:47 UTC, from docker inspect). The first consumer kept storing already-fetched messages until 18:29:25 (32,800 stored) and exited on its 60 s idle limit at 18:30:25 without having resumed. A second consumer (--idle-exit 20) then drained the topic. Counters from that consumer's own log; deliveries breakdown from stream_flights afterwards. Printed to the console during the run and saved here.
reading: Of the 32,800 flights stored by the first consumer only 16,800 had committed offsets: the 16,000 stored while the broker was down could not commit, were redelivered to the drain consumer and absorbed by the upsert (deliveries = 2, no duplicate documents). The consumer logged no warning for the failed commits.
